title: Surreal Ruins Lantern
description: A man in a dark trench coat and hat walks away from the viewer down the decaying balcony of an ornate classical building, holding a glowing lantern that casts a bright blue beam of light. The floor is littered with torn film strips, scattered photographs of faces and nuclear explosions, while a large crystal chandelier lies shattered on the ground.
prompt: A lone figure in a long dark coat and hat walks through the decaying balcony of a once-elegant classical building at dusk, holding a lantern emitting a strong blue beam. The floor is covered in scattered old film reels, torn photographs of faces and atomic explosions, and a massive shattered crystal chandelier. In the background, a barren orange desert stretches under a dramatic sky with green aurora borealis and distant mushroom clouds, surreal and cinematic atmosphere.
